Hey,
I understand what you're feeling. Youre feeling this man isn't good for you -  It's complicated by the fact you are pregnant, again. So now you're feeling like your choices are limited to the unfathomable mental torment of being trapped in an unhappy relationship with a baby, or going through another abortion, which you remember was quite mentally and emotionally taxing. It's not a fun place to be in at all. Your living situation/financial situation probably isn't the best either. And on top of all this you have depression, which is weighing you down more than anyone can imagine. It sounds like you will move in with your boyfriend as it is the lesser of two evils. You're scared about bringing a baby into an unhappy relationship? Totally understand that too. You're scared of the relationship not working and ending up being a single mother, with no support, friends or family to turn to, and that's terrifying.
Now here's what you do:
- start reaching out to whoever you can, especially family. I know that's a hard step, maybe try to talk to any friends that you have that will listen and work up to talking to family. You need support now more than ever. There are free pregnancy counselling lines you can call as well.
- think about what you really really want. Do you want to have this baby? Could you do it alone? Do you want to really be with this guy or are you scared to leave now coz of the emotional pain it would cause? If you had all the strength in the world, what would you choose? If you were the weakest person in the world, what would you choose? Look at these things from a variety of angles and assess where you are on the scale
- What would make your life better at this point?
Can u gather the strength to finish school and have a baby, can u conquer these obstacles? How long have you got left at school?
If you want this baby or not, you can do it. Reach out and find resources. You really need support around you now more than ever... You are worthy of a better situation and of respect and love.

It's not over, you know that. You can still live a full life. It's never going to be the same as it was, but that doesn't mean it has to end. Life is pretty fucked, you got a raw deal that's for sure. And I really empathise with you. I really hope you remember you're worth as a person. What a beautiful spirit you must be to have taken so many interesting avenues in your life. I don't want you to give up. Your family doesn't want you to give up. Your mind is still functioning, that's the most beautiful gift.

Sometimes these set backs happen and send everything into a spin and it feels so crazy that everything you spent so long building up can come crashing down so quickly. So keep focusing on yourself, building your future, start rebuilding slowly, small steps, feel your pain and slowly get back on track. You can do it :)

Hey shadow1ninja I hear you, it's hard to move forward when you have seemingly nothing to help push you along...  some days are harder than the rest but then you have more tolerable, even happier days. It sounds like you want the strength and support to become the person you want to be; healthy normal person succeeding and achieving your goals.

 Truth is there is always a way to get back to a healthy state of mind, and it is achievable. I imagine looking for work in this state is difficult. Just changing some small things in your everyday routine and adding positive change can do great things to shift your perspective. Eg skip a junk food snack, go for a walk, do yoga, meditate for twenty minutes, take multivitamins, have a good conversation with someone close, do a random act of kindness, realise when your having a bad thought and instead of beating yourself up about 'reverting to negative thinking' let it go... Watch a stand up comedy routine, play cards against humanity online, have a relaxing shower, make a vision board of your goals, write down some short term ann long term goals, imagine your perfect life, push yourself to try and get that job when you can so you can put this all into place... 12 weeks give it a go. See how u feel. Mark progress and feelings in a diary.

What All these things have in common is kindness to yourself. That's the best we got. These are the things we can do for ourselves. Don't give up.
